name: Mosslord Mask
body:
Price 31,500 gp; Slot head; CL 13th; Weight 1 lb.; Aura strong divination

DESCRIPTION

This fearsome wooden mask features narrow slits for eyes, but has no mouth. The wearer gains greensight 60 feet and has the constant benefit of speak with plants. They also gain a +4 bonus on saving throws against inhaled poisons, toxins, and molds (such as yellow mold).

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 15,750 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells greensight, speak with plants
